recommendation: Automated document processing with exception-based human review
notes: First cohort of DIRECT IMPLEMENTATION evidence (acquired via EDGAR full-text, passages verified verbatim). Comparability and outcome attribution are assigned by review and are independent of source verification. Records C1-C4 have explicit intervention->outcome attribution; C5 has direct implementation but uncertain attribution.

records.intervention: Technology and automation of people-based document processing services
records.what_it_establishes: A document-services firm's own automation program, with an attributed productivity outcome.

metrics.label: Revenue per FTE
metrics.passage: Revenue per head for SourceHOV has more than tripled ($18,000 per FTE in 2007 to $56,000 per FTE in 2016) with headcount being reduced by over 1,000 FTEs as a result of the adoption of its technology-focused strategy.

metrics.label: Headcount reduction
metrics.passage: headcount being reduced by over 1,000 FTEs as a result of the adoption of its technology-focused strategy.

records.comparability_reason: The company documents its own automation program and the source explicitly attributes the productivity outcome to it.
records.selection_reason: Direct implementation with explicit attribution; quantified revenue/FTE and headcount outcome.

records.intervention: Salesforce process automation + document workflow digitization
records.what_it_establishes: A bank's own process-automation and document-digitization program with reported returns.

metrics.label: Document storage/handling cost
metrics.passage: We are beginning to see returns on these investments in the form of time-saving efficiencies, reduced costs of document storage, handling and destruction, and a more comprehensive view of our customer relationships and opportunities.

metrics.label: Time savings
metrics.passage: Our investment in Salesforce process automation and the digitization of our document workflows, which we began in 2021 ... We are beginning to see returns on these investments in the form of time-saving efficiencies.

records.comparability_reason: The company documents its own process-automation and document-digitization program and attributes returns to it.
records.selection_reason: Direct implementation with explicit attribution; process + document workflow automation.

records.intervention: Robotic process automation for repetitive reporting and process work
records.what_it_establishes: A bank's own RPA implementation with processing-time and hours-saved outcomes.

metrics.label: Processing time
metrics.passage: Robotic process automation have reduced risk of error and reduced processing time from hours to minutes.

metrics.label: Manual hours saved
metrics.passage: Collectively hundreds of hours have been saved on daily, weekly, monthly and periodic repetitive manual processes.

records.comparability_reason: The bank documents its own RPA implementation and attributes processing-time and hour savings to it.
records.selection_reason: Direct implementation with explicit attribution; quantified processing-time and hours-saved outcomes.
